title: My Steam wishlist count isn’t growing, so I’ve spent the past month improving my game.
author: New_Consequence3669
selftext:
I released a demo on Steam, but wishlist numbers haven’t met my expectations, so I’ve held off on the full release and kept working on the game. There are still plenty of issues to address, but my main focus right now is character animations and combat feel.

I’m working on making hits and enemy reactions easier to read when enemies crowd the screen, and making the transition from dodging back into attacking feel more natural. I also want melee attacks and magic to feel distinct and satisfying.

I use Tripo for character models, refine the animations in Blender, and bring them into Unity. It’s an ongoing cycle of adjusting animations, testing how they feel in actual combat, and making further changes to improve movement and impact.

**The currently available Steam demo is an earlier version. It does not yet include the changes shown in this footage.**
